Action.name: AETHERPATH_TOGGLE
Action.Down: if AetherPath and AetherPath.UI then AetherPath.UI:ToggleTracker() end

Action.name: AETHERPATH_TRAVEL
Action.Down: if AetherPath and AetherPath.UI then AetherPath.UI:ToggleTravel() end

Action.name: AETHERPATH_CYCLE
Action.Down: if AetherPath and AetherPath.Tracker then AetherPath.Tracker:CycleNext() end

Action.name: AETHERPATH_LOCK
Action.Down: if AetherPath and AetherPath.sv then AetherPath.sv.trackerLocked = not AetherPath.sv.trackerLocked; if AetherPath.UI then AetherPath.UI:ApplyLock() end end
